# eSec

> llms.txt for the eSec repository (embeddedos-org/eSec).
> Status: security framework for EmbeddedOS. The implementation
> lives in `eos` (`services/security/` and `services/crypto/`);
> this repository is the component's issue tracker and
> decision record — it is deliberately not a code mirror.
> Whether code moves here is issue #5, which is Aswin's call.

eSec is the security framework of EmbeddedOS: reusable security
services above the boot chain — crypto abstraction, key
management, device identity, secure storage, capabilities and
permissions, attestation, certificates/TLS integration, and
TPM / secure element / HSM adapters. Today `eos` implements AES,
SHA-256 and SHA-512 (NIST vectors passing); RSA and ECC signature
verification are stubs that refuse to run unless a build defines
`EOS_ALLOW_STUB_CRYPTO`, and ADR-012 (in `eos`) selects Mbed TLS
to replace them.

- [CVD intake](docs/cvd-intake.md) — coordinated vulnerability disclosure report template and intake process

- [MCP hostile-protocol hardening](docs/mcp-hostile-protocol-hardening.md) — hardening notes for MCP protocol surfaces against hostile peers
- [security.txt](.well-known/security.txt) — RFC 9116 security contact
